The agent runtime at `/agent/mcp` serves each agent key's toolset as callable MCP tools (see [Agent access](../../bring-in/agent-access.mdx) to issue a key). It speaks a pinned set of MCP protocol versions, over Streamable HTTP only — the deprecated HTTP+SSE transport is never served there.

## Protocol versions

| Version | Status | `initialize` offering it settles on |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `2026-07-28` | Served | `2025-11-25` |
| `2025-11-25` | Served | `2025-11-25` |
| `2025-06-18` | Served | `2025-06-18` |
| `2025-03-26` | Legacy default — assumed when a request has no `MCP-Protocol-Version` header | `2025-03-26` |
| `2024-11-05` | Not served — the HTTP+SSE era; refused | `2025-11-25` |

**2026-07-28** has no `initialize` handshake, so an `initialize` that offers it is answered with `2025-11-25` — the version a 2026-07-28 client falls back to. Requests that carry `MCP-Protocol-Version: 2026-07-28` are accepted and recorded at that version.

## Unsupported versions are refused

A request whose `MCP-Protocol-Version` header names any other version — or two different versions — is refused with HTTP `400` before it reaches a tool, and is never served at another version. The body lists the versions to retry with:

```json
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": null,
  "error": {
    "code": -32022,
    "message": "Unsupported MCP-Protocol-Version '1999-01-01'; supported: 2026-07-28, 2025-11-25, 2025-06-18, 2025-03-26",
    "data": {
      "supported": [
        "2026-07-28",
        "2025-11-25",
        "2025-06-18",
        "2025-03-26"
      ],
      "requested": "1999-01-01"
    }
  }
}
```

## Conformance

Apiome runs its own `mcp-protocol` conformance profile against the agent runtime in CI, once per version above, and fails the build on any `error` finding — see [MCP conformance rules](../../govern/mcp-conformance-rules.md) for the rules and the specification revisions they cite.

The full matrix and the SDK decision behind it are in [`PROTOCOL_VERSIONS.md`](https://github.com/apiome/apiome/blob/main/apiome-mcp/docs/PROTOCOL_VERSIONS.md).
